title: Prismatic Shrine
description: A shrine hewn from a single enormous crystal pulses with slow, rhythmic light, as though it breathes. The air around it shimmers with impossible colors that have no name, and a profound calm settles over anyone who draws near.

choices.label: Meditate before the shrine
choices.description: The shrine's radiance washes over your party, mending wounds and easing fatigue.

outcomes.text: A warm prismatic glow envelops the party. Bruises fade and breathing steadies as the light does its work.
The shrine pulses brighter as you meditate, pouring restorative energy into every wound and weary muscle.
The meditation heals your bodies, but the alien colors seep into one hero's vision and refuse to leave.

choices.label: Offer gold to the shrine
choices.description: Place coins at the shrine's base. The crystal flares brightly, and deep healing floods through you.

outcomes.text: The coins dissolve into light at the shrine's base. A surge of prismatic energy floods through the party, mending all hurts.
The shrine accepts your offering and returns it tenfold. Wounds close, exhaustion lifts, and a faint warmth lingers in your bones.
The shrine absorbs the gold but gives nothing in return. Its light dims as though disappointed by the offering.

choices.label: Take a shard from the altar
choices.description: A sliver of the shrine's crystal hums with trapped temporal energy.

outcomes.text: You pry a sliver free. The shrine's light flickers but holds. The shard vibrates faintly with residual power.
The shard comes loose easily, as if the shrine offered it willingly. Echo essence drips from the fracture.
The shrine recoils as you break the shard free. A pulse of angry light shocks you, punishing the desecration.
